current_affairs_audit.caveat: Part IX constitutionalises institutions, elections and inclusion but leaves substantive devolution mainly to State law. PESA applies to Fifth Schedule Scheduled Areas with statutory modifications; digital uploads do not prove Gram Sabha power or actual three-F devolution.
